EU / GDPR portfolio note

This project uses a public portfolio dataset and is not used to make decisions about real people. In a real Irish or EU deployment, pseudonymous customer IDs, location, and behavioural data can still be personal data. A team would document a lawful basis and purpose, minimise fields, restrict access, define retention periods, assess profiling risk (including a DPIA where appropriate), support data-subject rights, and keep human review over any retention action. The model should prioritise outreach—not make automated adverse decisions.
